title: Samsung's Processing-in-Memory (PIM)
summary: Samsung's Processing-in-Memory (PIM) technology integrates computation directly into HBM memory, enabling in-memory data processing to eliminate the memory bandwidth bottleneck and reduce data movement energy costs in AI and high-performance computing workloads.
problem_solved: Eliminates the memory wall problem by performing computations where data resides, reducing costly data movement between processor and memory.
why_valuable: Dramatically improves performance and energy efficiency for AI/ML workloads by avoiding expensive memory accesses and leveraging massive parallelism in memory arrays.
